Name: Poise limits repeated interruption
Limits / Exceptions: Keep poise separate from health; build pressure toward stagger. Define thresholds, recovery, boss resistance, and whether Force and Static use the same poise budget.
Result: Interruption occurs only after a threshold or against a vulnerable action.
Trigger / Conditions: Repeated impacts or Static hits build poise pressure.

Name: Ignition propagates to susceptible targets
Limits / Exceptions: Fire may propagate only on Ignition to susceptible targets or surfaces within a defined range. Each target can trigger at most one propagation event per chain; use a re-ignition lockout to prevent loops.
Result: Nearby targets or surfaces may ignite, creating conditional area pressure.
Trigger / Conditions: Ignition occurs near a susceptible target within propagation range.

Name: Fearless resists Fear only
Limits / Exceptions: Fearless does not resist all Soul damage, essence drain, Silence, or other effects that lack the Fear tag.
Result: Fear buildup, duration, or severity is reduced or prevented according to the trait's tier.
Trigger / Conditions: A Fear-tagged effect attempts to apply to a Fearless target.

Name: Mucus constrains Dodge routes
Limits / Exceptions: Must not globally disable Dodge. Existing coating/patches are not cleared by dodging.
Result: Movement options may be reduced or dodge distance shortened while crossing a sticky zone or while Adhered.
Trigger / Conditions: A dodge path crosses a sticky surface or an Adhered target tries to move.

Name: Squishy absorbs physical impact
Limits / Exceptions: This is not immunity. Keep proportional reduction distinct from Shell's fixed reduction per layer; it grants no blanket status resistance.
Result: Qualifying physical damage is proportionally reduced and physical impulse/knockback may also be reduced.
Trigger / Conditions: A qualifying physical Force hit or impulse affects a Squishy-protected target.

Name: Membrane absorbs eligible direct damage
Limits / Exceptions: Statuses are prevented only if the applying delivery hit is blocked under that attack's rule. Existing statuses and persistent hazards remain. Membrane regenerates after a short no-shield-damage period.
Result: The shield pool absorbs eligible direct damage before health until depleted.
Trigger / Conditions: An eligible direct-damage component hits an active Membrane.

Name: Bloodless blocks Exsanguination
Limits / Exceptions: Do not silently convert this into immunity to all Blood damage.
Result: Extraction and blood-resource gain are prevented unless an alternate resource rule exists.
Trigger / Conditions: An ability attempts to extract usable blood.

Name: Force drives targets into hazards
Limits / Exceptions: Requires an actual hazard and valid path; no automatic bonus damage in empty terrain.
Result: Positioning converts Force displacement into extra exposure or conditional ignition.
Trigger / Conditions: Knockback pushes a target into a persistent flame or flammable hazard.

Name: Fear does not equal all Soul damage
Limits / Exceptions: Prevents a broad trait from accidentally countering an entire damage type.
Result: Fearless provides no benefit unless the effect carries the Fear tag.
Trigger / Conditions: A Soul attack deals damage or drains essence without applying Fear.

Name: Shell and Burn remain separate layers
Limits / Exceptions: Resolve the physical hit component separately from Burn application and later burning-zone exposure. Do not add blanket status immunity.
Result: Shell reduces qualifying physical components but does not inherently resist heat or Burn.
Trigger / Conditions: A Fire attack applies direct damage and/or Burn to a Shell-protected target.

Name: Essence-targeting Soul may bypass Shell or Membrane
Limits / Exceptions: Soul damage does not automatically bypass defences by type label alone. Special wards and explicit shield rules may still apply.
Result: Only the explicitly essence-targeting component may bypass the named physical defence.
Trigger / Conditions: An attack component explicitly tagged as targeting essence hits a target protected by Shell or Membrane.

Name: Static chains through conductive targets
Limits / Exceptions: Use chain budgets and conductivity requirements; avoid unrestricted jumps.
Result: Static can chain damage or interruption across a limited number of targets.
Trigger / Conditions: Valid conductive paths connect multiple targets.

Name: Acid + Fire — Premature Evaporation
Limits / Exceptions: The reaction consumes the target coating; Acid pools do not automatically explode. Keep the burst modest and prevent retriggering from the same coating.
Result: The Acid coating is consumed in a modest close-range burst.
Trigger / Conditions: A Fire attack hits a target that visibly carries Acid coating.

Name: Fire Resistance slows Burn
Limits / Exceptions: Reduced buildup, reduced ticks, delayed Ignition, and full immunity are separate parameters. Fire Resistance does not inherently reduce physical impact.
Result: Burn buildup or Burn damage is reduced; Ignition may be delayed only if separately defined.
Trigger / Conditions: Fire attempts to apply Burn buildup or Burn damage to a resistant target.

Name: Bloodless prevents blood-dependent effects
Limits / Exceptions: Does not prevent direct Blood-type damage or non-bleeding wound effects by default.
Result: The blood-dependent Bleed or extraction component fails or uses an explicitly designed alternate effect.
Trigger / Conditions: A Blood effect requires blood loss, bleeding, or usable blood extraction.

Name: Extinguishing suppresses Fire
Limits / Exceptions: Do not introduce a Water damage type or assume every environment has an extinguishing mechanic. Special Fire effects require explicit rules.
Result: A successful, explicitly supported extinguishing action reduces Burn exposure or stops further propagation.
Trigger / Conditions: A specific extinguishing action or authored environmental counter successfully affects a burning target or zone.

Name: Acid erodes Shell
Limits / Exceptions: Shell layers do not regenerate during the encounter. Show each layer loss. Acid does not automatically stop Membrane regeneration or bypass all defences.
Result: Corrosion erodes or removes finite Shell layers, improving later qualifying hits.
Trigger / Conditions: Acid hits or sustained explicitly corrosive exposure affects a Shell-protected target.

Name: Mucus + Fire — Flammable Mucus
Limits / Exceptions: The patch is consumed after one short burn. No lingering Mucus slow after ignition; reaction-created fire cannot retrigger itself.
Result: The patch burns briefly as a small temporary no-go zone, then is consumed.
Trigger / Conditions: A Fire attack ignites a visible Mucus patch.

Name: Membrane interaction with Soul effects
Limits / Exceptions: Soul damage does not bypass the shield by type label alone. Do not imply every Soul ability phases through barriers.
Result: Eligible direct Soul damage is absorbed normally. Only an explicitly essence-targeting component may bypass Membrane when the attack is tagged for that exception.
Trigger / Conditions: A Soul attack meets an active Membrane.

Name: Dodge avoids eligible attacks
Limits / Exceptions: AoE edges may still hit; Dodge does not remove existing statuses or persistent hazards. Each attack defines its own hitbox/coverage rules.
Result: A clean miss prevents the hit and its attached effects.
Trigger / Conditions: Timing and positioning move the defender outside the attack's actual hitbox under its tracking rules.

Name: Acid + Mucus — Slick Move
Limits / Exceptions: Convert rather than layer hazards. Show the new boundary and expiry; do not leave the old sticky effect underneath.
Result: The Mucus patch is replaced by a short-lived corrosive slick.
Trigger / Conditions: An Acid attack hits a visible Mucus patch.

Name: Static + Soul — Interference Pattern
Limits / Exceptions: No general interrupt against every Soul enemy or every Soul hit. Respect the attack's interrupt window and poise rules.
Result: The Soul attack is interrupted.
Trigger / Conditions: A Static combo hits during a clearly telegraphed Soul attack.

Name: Blood + Soul — Blood Donor
Limits / Exceptions: Cap the heal and prevent repeat-hit farming. No new resource meter; do not heal on every Blood tick.
Result: The player restores a small fixed amount of health.
Trigger / Conditions: A Blood attack hits a visibly Soul-marked target.

Name: Force + Acid — Corrosive Splash
Limits / Exceptions: Requires a visible Acid coating. Keep the splash small and bounded; it must not trigger another splash recursively.
Result: A small splash spreads Acid to nearby enemies, spreading the setup rather than adding a large second burst.
Trigger / Conditions: A Force strike hits a target visibly coated in Acid.

Name: Force + Soul — Soul Purpose
Limits / Exceptions: No fragment or pickup system. Exposure is brief and must be visually signalled.
Result: The hit breaks the mark and briefly exposes the target to the next Soul hit.
Trigger / Conditions: A Force hit connects with a visibly Soul-marked target.

Name: Static + Mucus — Sticky Situation
Limits / Exceptions: One trigger per patch, with a clear charge cue and expiry. No repeated shocks from the same patch.
Result: The next enemy entering the patch is briefly shocked.
Trigger / Conditions: A Static attack charges a visible Mucus patch.

Name: Mucus + Soul — Held in Suspension
Limits / Exceptions: The visible mark is the trigger. Keep the pin short and avoid adding extra damage or another status.
Result: The target is briefly pinned in place.
Trigger / Conditions: A Mucus attack hits a visibly Soul-marked target.

Name: Force + Blood — Blood Pressure
Limits / Exceptions: Do not add another Bleed stack or create a large pool.
Result: The existing wound bursts for one small area hit.
Trigger / Conditions: A Force finisher hits a bleeding target.

Name: Mucus + Blood — Caught in the Clot
Limits / Exceptions: The patch catches once and then is consumed or disabled. Blood must be visibly present; no long immobilisation.
Result: The first enemy crossing the patch is briefly caught.
Trigger / Conditions: A named Mucus/Blood combo creates a visibly blood-laced clot patch.

Name: Blood + Fire — Cauterise
Limits / Exceptions: The burst should compensate for ending the Bleed. Do not apply a fresh Burn by default.
Result: The existing Bleed is consumed for one immediate burst.
Trigger / Conditions: A Fire attack hits a bleeding target.

Name: Force + Mucus — Snot Rocket
Limits / Exceptions: One payoff only: no extra stun or bonus-damage layer. Landing patch has a clear boundary and short lifetime.
Result: The enemy launches in the hit direction and leaves one small sticky patch on landing.
Trigger / Conditions: A Force attack hits a Mucus-stuck enemy.

Name: Acid + Static — Conductive Pool
Limits / Exceptions: The pulse stays within the visible pool boundary and occurs once; no repeated pulses or infinite chain.
Result: One electrical pulse travels across the puddle.
Trigger / Conditions: A Static attack hits a visible Acid puddle.

Name: Acid + Soul — Soul Erosion
Limits / Exceptions: Do not invent a new defence/resource for the reaction. One clear outcome per target; the fallback is a brief mark refresh.
Result: The reaction consumes the mark to weaken an explicit Soul ward; if the target has no such ward, refresh the mark briefly instead.
Trigger / Conditions: An Acid combo hits a visibly Soul-marked target.

Name: Static + Fire — Arc Flash
Limits / Exceptions: One arc only. Do not stack extra Burn, stun, and multi-jump chaining into one reaction.
Result: One short arc jumps to the nearest other eligible enemy.
Target: Burning target and one nearby enemy
Trigger / Conditions: A Static attack hits a burning target.

Name: Static + Blood — Blood Circuit
Limits / Exceptions: Select one target only; do not pulse across the whole pool or chain onward.
Result: One arc hits the nearest eligible enemy standing in or beside the pool.
Target: Visible blood pool and nearby enemy
Trigger / Conditions: A Static attack hits a visible blood pool.

Name: Force + Fire — Flashover
Limits / Exceptions: One jump only; no uncontrolled propagation chain. Distinct from pushing an enemy into an existing hazard.
Result: A small tongue of flame jumps to one nearby eligible target.
Target: Burning target and one nearby enemy
Trigger / Conditions: A Force weapon hits a burning target.

Name: Soul + Fire — Spectral Combustion
Limits / Exceptions: Trigger on a hit, not only on defeat. One burst only; do not add an unbounded Fire propagation chain.
Result: The mark is consumed in a short spectral burst.
Trigger / Conditions: A named Soul/Fire combo hits a burning target that also has a visible Soul Mark.

Name: Acid + Blood — Caustic Breach
Limits / Exceptions: Defence erosion only: no extra damage-over-time and no new wound stack. Make the erosion visible.
Result: The hit strips more Armour/Shell effectiveness than Acid alone.
Trigger / Conditions: A named Acid combo hits a bleeding target.

Name: Force + Static — Shocking Impact
Limits / Exceptions: Requires the named combo, not merely two unrelated hits on the same target. No chain reaction.
Result: A short local electrical burst occurs around the impact.
Trigger / Conditions: A named Force/Static weapon combo lands.

Name: Heavy Force can shed a Shell layer
Limits / Exceptions: Requires the heavy-hit threshold and a clear visual layer-loss cue. Lost layers do not regenerate during the encounter.
Result: One Shell layer is knocked loose, reducing protection for later qualifying hits.
Trigger / Conditions: A sufficiently heavy Force impact hits a Shell-protected target.

Name: Thorns retaliate once on contact
Limits / Exceptions: Thorns does not mitigate the incoming hit and triggers once per hit, not once per damage component. Ranged attacks, remote hazards, non-contact effects, and cleanly Dodged attacks do not trigger it.
Result: Thorns returns damage once for that attack hit.
Trigger / Conditions: A qualifying melee/contact attack connects with a Thorns-protected target.

Name: Static recharges or supercharges Membrane
Limits / Exceptions: Bound the benefit and show it clearly. Repeated hits must not create an infinite recharge loop.
Result: The Membrane rapidly recharges or briefly supercharges, with a visible cue.
Trigger / Conditions: A defined Static hit or named Static interaction affects an active Membrane.

Name: Membrane resists Force impact
Limits / Exceptions: Measurable resistance, not immunity. Resolve the physical hit and impulse separately; do not make Membrane a blanket status shield.
Result: Force drains the shield less efficiently and causes less knockback while the shield remains active.
Trigger / Conditions: A qualifying Force hit strikes a target while its Membrane is active.
